subject: Highlighting a particular area of a plot

messages.author: 4b890229d8cfaf55
messages.subject: Highlighting a particular area of a plot
parts:
Hi all,

Please consider following :

library(zoo); library(ggplot2)
dat1 <- as.yearmon(seq(as.Date("2008-01-01"), by = "1 month", length =
20))
dat <- zoo(rnorm(20), dat1); dat


Now I want to highlight the area of above plot starting from May-2008
to June-2009, with some other color. Can anyone please tell me how to
do that?

Thanks,

On Sat, Dec 19, 2009 at 06:40, Bogaso <bogaso.c...@gmail.com> wrote:
> Please consider following :
>
> library(zoo); library(ggplot2)
> dat1 <- as.yearmon(seq(as.Date("2008-01-01"), by = "1 month", length =
> 20))
> dat <- zoo(rnorm(20), dat1); dat
>
>
> Now I want to highlight the area of above plot starting from May-2008
> to June-2009, with some other color. Can anyone please tell me how to
> do that?

Once you have the coordinate converted to date, you can either:
- select the part of your data that you want to highlight and replot
it with a different colour, e.g.
last_plot() + geom_path(aes(x=dat1, y=whatever),
data=dat[dat$dat1>"2008-05-01" & dat$dat1<"2009-06-30",],
colour="red")
- use annonate() to draw coloured a rectangle above this region of the
graph (see ?annotate)

JiHO
